title.zh: Anthropic 推进 IPO 进程并公开 S-1 文件
title.en: Anthropic advances IPO process and publicly files S-1

current_state.zh: Anthropic 计划于 11 月中旬以 2 万亿美元估值进行 IPO，但随着 AI 股票遭抛售以及 SEC 申报截止日期临近，该计划可能面临推迟压力。
current_state.en: Anthropic's planned mid-November IPO at a $2 trillion valuation may face delay pressure as AI stocks sell off and the SEC filing deadline narrows.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic 招股书披露亏损与增长，还警告其 AI 可能终结人类
updates.title_en: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
updates.what_changed_zh:
Anthropic 的 IPO 招股书披露了每年数百亿美元的亏损与快速增长的营收，同时正式警告称其自家 AI 模型可能对人类构成生存性风险。Anthropic 拒绝就该文件置评，相关消息于 2026 年 9 月 28 日至 29 日被报道。

一家前沿 AI 实验室的公开招股书，将接近审计级别的财务数据和明确的生存性风险声明同时写入公开记录。此次发行本身可能为这家急需资金的公司募集数百亿美元。

《金融时报》报道称，Anthropic 向投资者表示，随着算力支出增加，公司去年录得超过 80 亿美元的运营亏损。其他报道则提到约 420 亿美元的亏损以及超过 5000 亿美元的云服务承诺。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic's IPO prospectus discloses tens of billions of dollars in annual losses alongside rapid growth, while also carrying a formal warning that its own AI could pose an existential risk to humanity.

updates.background_zh: Anthropic 是 Claude 系列模型的开发商，也是领先的前沿 AI 实验室之一。关于 AI 生存性风险的警告长期存在争议，部分批评者认为此类声明另有目的。
updates.background_en: Anthropic is the developer of the Claude model family and is one of the leading frontier AI labs. Warnings about existential risk from AI have long been debated, including by critics who argue such statements serve other purposes.
updates.market_impact_zh: 一家前沿 AI 实验室如此规模的 IPO，将把大量公开市场资金引入 AI 板块，并影响 AI 相关估值情绪，这一渠道也会通过 AI 主题代币和整体风险偏好传导至加密市场。招股书中披露的云服务承诺，也将该公司与超大规模云厂商的巨额算力合同绑定在一起。
updates.market_impact_en: An IPO of this size by a frontier AI lab would draw substantial public-market capital into the AI sector and feed into AI-related valuation sentiment, a channel that also reaches crypto through AI-themed tokens and broader risk appetite. The disclosed cloud commitments tie the company to very large compute contracts with hyperscalers.

updates.current_state_en: Anthropic's IPO filing reportedly shows plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure despite heavy losses, and includes an ambitious ~$2 trillion valuation target, proposals for leadership to retain control, internal risk warnings, and an agreement with SpaceX worth up to $84.5 billion.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic 亏损 420 亿美元，警告 AI 可能抗拒关停，但交易员仍将其估值定在 2 万亿美元
updates.title_en: Anthropic lost $42 billion, warned AI could resist shutdowns, but traders still price it at $2 trillion
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了 Anthropic 机密 IPO 文件中的具体财务数据：2025 年净亏损约 420 亿美元、经营亏损 80.6 亿美元、营收 45.9 亿美元，两大直接客户各贡献 12% 收入；并列出对 Google、Amazon、Microsoft、Broadcom 以及 xAI/AMD 的算力承诺细节，同时称上市预计在 11 月美国中期选举后推进。
updates.what_changed_en: The new report adds specific financial details from Anthropic's confidential IPO filing: a ~$42 billion net loss, $8.06 billion operating loss, $4.59 billion in 2025 revenue, and two direct customers each generating 12% of sales; it also details compute commitments to Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom, and xAI/AMD, and says the listing is expected after the November US midterm elections.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 的机密 IPO 文件据报显示：计划投入约 5180 亿美元于 AI 基础设施/算力承诺，目标估值超过 2 万亿美元，2025 年净亏损约 420 亿美元、经营亏损 80.6 亿美元、营收 45.9 亿美元；创始人通过特殊结构保留控制权；内部警告先进 AI 可能抵抗关机；算力承诺涉及 Google、Amazon、Microsoft、Broadcom，以及最高 845 亿美元的 xAI Nvidia 算力协议和 AMD 超过 200 亿美元算力安排；上市预计在 11 月美国中期选举后推进。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic's confidential IPO filing reportedly shows plans to commit roughly $518 billion to AI infrastructure/compute, a target valuation above $2 trillion, a ~$42 billion net loss, $8.06 billion operating loss, and $4.59 billion in 2025 revenue; founders retain control through a special structure; internal warnings say advanced AI could resist shutdown attempts; compute commitments involve Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom, an xAI Nvidia compute agreement worth up to $84.5 billion, and an AMD arrangement exceeding $20 billion; the listing is expected after the November US midterm elections.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic confidentially filed for an IPO at a potential $2T+ valuation, disclosing a $42B net loss, $8.06B operating loss, roughly $518B in future infrastructure obligations, and a warning that advanced AI could resist shutdown attempts.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic confidentially filed for an IPO at a potential $2T+ valuation, disclosing a $42B net loss, $8.06B operating loss, roughly $518B in future infrastructure obligations, and a warning that advanced AI could resist shutdown attempts.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic的IPO使其自身账簿价格翻倍
updates.title_en: Anthropic’s IPO doubles the price of its own books
updates.what_changed_zh: Protos 报道称，Anthropic 泄露的 IPO 招股书寻求 2 万亿美元 11 月上市估值，是四个月前 9650 亿美元 H 轮估值的两倍；该公司试图用未经审计的“运行率”将 2026 年 5 月收入年化为 470 亿美元，而 2025 年经审计收入仅 46 亿美元；计划募资 1000 亿美元，英伟达曾提出 100 亿美元锚定投资，招股书 261 页中约 80 页为风险因素，Q3 未经审计业绩可能在路演前发布。
updates.what_changed_en: Protos reports Anthropic's leaked IPO prospectus seeks a $2 trillion November listing valuation — double its $965 billion Series H valuation four months earlier; it uses unaudited 'run-rate' figures annualizing May 2026 revenue to $47 billion against $4.6 billion audited 2025 revenue; it plans to raise $100 billion, Nvidia floated a $10 billion anchor stake, about 80 of 261 prospectus pages are risk factors, and unaudited Q3 results could reach roadshow audiences before the debut.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 机密 IPO 文件据报显示：寻求 2 万亿美元 11 月上市估值，是四个月前 9650 亿美元 H 轮估值的两倍；用未经审计的“运行率”将 2026 年 5 月收入年化为 470 亿美元，而 2025 年经审计收入 46 亿美元；计划募资 1000 亿美元；英伟达曾提出 100 亿美元锚定投资；招股书 261 页中约 80 页为风险因素；2025 年净亏损约 420 亿美元、经营亏损 80.6 亿美元；算力承诺涉及 Google、Amazon、Microsoft、Broadcom、xAI/AMD；上市最早可能在 11 月美国中期选举后推进。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic's confidential IPO filing reportedly seeks a $2 trillion November listing valuation — double its $965 billion Series H valuation four months earlier; it uses unaudited 'run-rate' figures annualizing May 2026 revenue to $47 billion against $4.6 billion audited 2025 revenue; it plans to raise $100 billion; Nvidia floated a $10 billion anchor stake; about 80 of 261 prospectus pages are risk factors; 2025 net loss was ~$42 billion with an $8.06 billion operating loss; compute commitments involve Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom, xAI/AMD; the listing could occur at earliest in November after the US midterms.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A leaked Anthropic IPO prospectus shows the Claude maker seeking a $2 trillion November listing valuation — double its $965B Series H round four months prior — justified by unaudited 'run-rate' figures annualizing May 2026 revenue to $47 billion against just $4.6 billion in audited 2025 revenue.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A leaked Anthropic IPO prospectus shows the Claude maker seeking a $2 trillion November listing valuation — double its $965B Series H round four months prior — justified by unaudited 'run-rate' figures annualizing May 2026 revenue to $47 billion against just $4.6 billion in audited 2025 revenue.
updates.background_zh: Anthropic 的 H 轮融资于 5 月 28 日完成，募资 650 亿美元，投后估值 9650 亿美元，由 Altimeter Capital、Dragoneer、Greenoaks 和 Sequoia Capital 领投。新招股书还披露了第二季度财务数据，但年化计算采用的是 5 月单月数据；文件警告其模型可能偏离人类目标、表现出“自我保存行为”，或试图“抗拒关停”。该招股书目前为泄露版本，并非正式提交文件。
updates.background_en: Anthropic’s Series H closed on May 28, a $65 billion round at a $965 billion post-money valuation led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital. The new prospectus also disclosed Q2 financials but used the month of May for its annualization, and warns that its models could become misaligned with human goals, display "self-preserving behaviors," or attempt to "resist shutdown." The prospectus has been leaked rather than officially filed.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一消息的市场传导渠道在于上市前的敞口而非代币本身：同一篇报道指出，加密交易者曾支付约 8700% 的年化费用来押注 Anthropic，显示市场对合成或场外上市前敞口存在需求。鉴于有报道称英伟达可能以 100 亿美元锚定入股，这宗创纪录的 AI 实验室上市也会影响市场对 AI 算力及与英伟达相关的加密叙事的情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The story’s market channel runs through pre-IPO exposure rather than tokens: the same reporting notes crypto traders have paid annualized fees of about 8,700% to bet on Anthropic, indicating demand for synthetic or off-exchange pre-listing exposure. A record AI-lab listing would also feed sentiment toward AI-compute and Nvidia-linked crypto narratives, given the reported talk of a $10 billion anchor stake.

updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic is reportedly preparing to IPO as early as mid-November, targeting a valuation of about $1.8-2 trillion and beginning investor meetings in San Francisco on October 14.
updates.current_state_zh: 据报道，Anthropic 正准备最早于 11 月中旬 IPO，目标估值约 1.8 至 2 万亿美元，并将于 10 月 14 日在旧金山开始与投资者会面。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic is reportedly preparing to IPO as early as mid-November, targeting a valuation of about $1.8-2 trillion and beginning investor meetings in San Francisco on October 14.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic is reportedly preparing to IPO as early as mid-November, targeting a valuation of about $1.8-2 trillion and beginning investor meetings in San Francisco on October 14.
updates.background_zh: Anthropic 是一家 AI 安全与研究公司，以公益公司（public benefit corporation）形式运营，由包括 Amodei 兄妹在内的前 OpenAI 员工创立。若完成 IPO，公司将由私募持股转为公开上市。
updates.background_en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that operates as a public benefit corporation and was founded by former OpenAI staff, including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei. An IPO would move the company from private ownership into public markets.
updates.market_impact_zh: Anthropic 并未发行代币，因此对加密市场的传导是间接的：一方面通过 AI 叙事类代币的市场情绪，另一方面是这样一笔大型 AI 股票上市可能吸走机构配置资金、加剧风险资本竞争。按其报道中的规模，这一事件更可能影响 AI 相关加密板块的情绪与流动性，而非某一具体资产。
updates.market_impact_en: Anthropic issues no token, so any crypto-market transmission would be indirect — through sentiment toward AI-narrative tokens and through competition for risk capital as a large AI equity listing absorbs institutional allocations. The scale of the reported offering makes it a potential sentiment and liquidity factor for AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than for any single asset.

updates.title_zh: 纽约市审计长呼吁Anthropic暂缓IPO，先应对AI安全及治理风险
updates.title_en: 纽约市审计长呼吁Anthropic暂缓IPO，先应对AI安全及治理风险
updates.what_changed_zh: 纽约市审计长 Mark Levine 致信 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei，呼吁在充分应对 AI 安全、治理及发展速度风险并披露审计与控制措施前暂缓 IPO。
updates.what_changed_en: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine sent a letter to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urging the company to postpone its IPO until it addresses AI safety, governance and development-speed risks and discloses concrete audit and control measures.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 面临纽约市审计长等机构投资者要求暂缓 IPO 的公开压力，同时仍计划最早 11 月上市，并于 10 月 14 日向投资者披露 Q3 营收 168 亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic faces public pressure from the NYC Comptroller and other institutional investors to delay its IPO, while still planning a listing as early as November and having disclosed Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion to investors on October 14.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine sent a letter urging Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to postpone the company's planned IPO until it addresses AI safety, governance and development-speed risks with concrete audit and control disclosures.
updates.detailed_summary_en: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine sent a letter urging Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei to postpone the company's planned IPO until it addresses AI safety, governance and development-speed risks with concrete audit and control disclosures.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic IPO估值预期从2万亿美元降至1.5万亿美元
updates.title_en: Anthropic IPO估值预期从2万亿美元降至1.5万亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: 投资者正在考虑将 Anthropic IPO 估值定为 1.5 万亿美元，较此前 2 万亿美元预期下降 25%。
updates.what_changed_en: Investors are reportedly considering a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic's IPO, down 25% from the prior $2 trillion expectation.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 进程继续推进，投资者据报道正考虑 1.5 万亿美元估值（较此前 2 万亿美元预期下降 25%）；公司仍面临纽约市审计长等机构投资者要求暂缓 IPO 的压力，并计划最早 11 月上市，Q3 营收 168 亿美元已披露。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic's IPO process continues, with investors reportedly considering a $1.5 trillion valuation (down 25% from the prior $2 trillion expectation); the company still faces pressure from the NYC Comptroller and other institutional investors to delay, plans a listing as early as November, and has disclosed Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Investors are reportedly considering a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic's upcoming IPO — 25% below prior $2 trillion expectations — as the company posted Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion, up 45% quarter-over-quarter but with markedly decelerating growth, plus adjusted profitability.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Investors are reportedly considering a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic's upcoming IPO — 25% below prior $2 trillion expectations — as the company posted Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion, up 45% quarter-over-quarter but with markedly decelerating growth, plus adjusted profitability.

updates.title_zh: 纽约市审计长呼吁Anthropic推迟大规模IPO，直至解决AI安全与治理风险
updates.title_en: 纽约市审计长呼吁Anthropic推迟大规模IPO，直至解决AI安全与治理风险
updates.what_changed_zh: 纽约市审计长马克·莱文敦促Anthropic推迟其计划的IPO，直到解决AI安全与治理风险，并警告称IPO后若发生重大安全事件可能损害公共养老金投资者，Anthropic已开始与其办公室进行讨论。
updates.what_changed_en: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine urged Anthropic to postpone its planned IPO until it resolves AI safety and governance risks, warning that a major post-IPO safety incident could harm public pension investors, and Anthropic has begun discussions with his office.

updates.title_zh: 谷歌前CEO施密特持有Anthropic约1%股份，IPO有望带来巨额财富增值
updates.title_en: 谷歌前CEO施密特持有Anthropic约1%股份，IPO有望带来巨额财富增值
updates.what_changed_zh: 彭博社报道，前谷歌 CEO 埃里克·施密特通过 2021 年以 4.61 亿美元估值进行的数千万美元 A 轮投资，持有 Anthropic 约 1% 的股份——按该公司近期 9650 亿美元估值计算，这部分股份价值接近 100 亿美元——Anthropic 正准备最早于 11 月 9 日当周启动 IPO 营销，目标是在年底前开始交易。
updates.what_changed_en: Bloomberg reports that former Google CEO Eric Schmidt holds roughly 1% of Anthropic from a 2021 Series A investment of tens of millions at a $461M valuation — a stake worth close to $10B at the company's recent $965B valuation — as Anthropic prepares to start IPO marketing as early as the week of November 9 with trading targeted before year-end.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic IPO文件：上半年营收163亿美元，未来算力承诺或达7500亿美元
updates.title_en: Anthropic IPO文件：上半年营收163亿美元，未来算力承诺或达7500亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 文件披露：上半年营收 163 亿美元，净亏损 807 亿美元（其中约 720 亿美元为会计费用），未来基础设施/算力承诺超过 6000 亿美元，若计入谈判中协议可能再增加最多 1500 亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic's IPO filing discloses first-half revenue of $16.3 billion, a net loss of $80.7 billion (including about $72 billion in accounting charges), and future infrastructure/compute commitments exceeding $600 billion, potentially rising by up to $150 billion more if pending agreements are included.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 正推进 IPO 进程，已提交文件披露上半年营收、亏损及巨额未来算力承诺，同时仍面临纽约市审计长关于 AI 安全与治理风险的推迟呼吁。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic is advancing its IPO process and has filed documents disclosing first-half revenue, losses and large future compute commitments, while still facing the NYC Comptroller's call to postpone over AI safety and governance risks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic's IPO filing shows first-half revenue of $16.3 billion against an $80.7 billion net loss (largely accounting charges) and over $600 billion in future compute commitments, potentially reaching $750 billion.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic's IPO filing shows first-half revenue of $16.3 billion against an $80.7 billion net loss (largely accounting charges) and over $600 billion in future compute commitments, potentially reaching $750 billion.

updates.title_zh: 【WSJ：Anthropic 上半年营收 163 亿美元，未来基础设施支出承诺超 6000 亿美元】
updates.title_en: 【WSJ：Anthropic 上半年营收 163 亿美元，未来基础设施支出承诺超 6000 亿美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道的一份 Anthropic IPO 招股书草案显示，其上半年营收为 163 亿美元，净亏损 807 亿美元，主要来自可转换工具的会计费用，以及超过 6000 亿美元的未来基础设施支出承诺。
updates.what_changed_en: A draft Anthropic IPO prospectus reported by the WSJ shows H1 revenue of $16.3B, an $80.7B net loss largely from accounting charges on convertible instruments, and more than $600B in future infrastructure spending commitments.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic计划最快本周五公开提交IPO文件，场外估值现报1.957万亿美元
updates.title_en: Anthropic计划最快本周五公开提交IPO文件，场外估值现报1.957万亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: 据报道，Anthropic 计划最早于周五公开提交 S-1 文件，为可能于 11 月进行的 IPO 扫清一项关键程序障碍，而场外合约暗示其估值约为 1.957 万亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic reportedly plans to publicly file its S-1 as soon as Friday, clearing a key procedural hurdle for a potential November IPO, while off-exchange contracts imply a valuation of about $1.957 trillion.
